say:3:1220405001:1.text: Who were those guys? So aggressive and arrogant, and they couldn't even take a beating!
say:3:1220405001:1.source_cn: 刚才那些既凶又嚣张还不耐打的人是谁啊？

say:4:1220405002:1.text: Boxing… the big boss… Kid, are you a fighter in the underground scene? Are they the bookies trying to get you to take a dive?
say:4:1220405002:1.source_cn: 拳赛……大老板……小子，你是地下拳手？他们是庄家的人，...

say:6:1220405003:1.text: How come you know…? Oh, right, you're one of leaders of the Whispers. There's nothing in Rustport you don't know...
say:6:1220405003:1.source_cn: 你？你怎么……也对，你是血薇帮的二号人物，锈锚港没什么...

say:7:1220405004:1.text: I'm Stanton. Yesterday, the bookies sent someone to "persuade" me to throw my next fight. I refused, and these people came knocking on my door today.
say:7:1220405004:1.source_cn: 我叫斯坦顿。昨天庄家派人“通知”我，让我下场拳赛做样子...

say:8:1220405005:1.text: "Iron Fist" Stanton? I've heard of you. You've got that famous left hook. What's wrong, don't want to throw the fight?
say:8:1220405005:1.source_cn: “铁手”斯坦顿？我听说过你，左勾拳挺出名的家伙。怎么，...

say:9:1220405006:1.text: A rigged fight? No way! I could've taken those punks if they came at me one-on-one… All the same, thanks a lot. It would've ended pretty badly if you hadn't stepped in.
say:9:1220405006:1.source_cn: 假拳？我呸！刚才也就是他们人多我才会吃亏……无论如何，...

say:10:1220405007:1.text: Throwing a fight is despicable! You made the right choice!
say:10:1220405007:1.source_cn: 打假拳是种堕落的行为！你这么做是对的！

say:11:1220405008:1.text: You've got some spunk, kid. How about signing on with the Whispers? With me by your side, no one would dare mess with you.
say:11:1220405008:1.source_cn: 你倒是有点意思。怎样，愿不愿意加入血薇帮，跟在我身边？...

say:14:1220405010:1.text: I just want to focus on boxing. I don't want to join a gang. I'm not saying the Whispers are bad, it's just not for me…
say:14:1220405010:1.source_cn: 我只想当个拳击手，不想加入黑帮。我、我不是说血薇帮不好...

say:15:1220405011:1.text: No need to explain. I won't force you. But since you're not with us, just know I'm not obligated to help you.
say:15:1220405011:1.source_cn: 不用解释，我不会强迫你。但你不是血薇帮的人，我也没义务...

say:16:1220405012:0.text: Don't be afraid! Chippy is a knight of justice, and Chippy vows to teach those thugs a lesson!
say:16:1220405012:0.source_cn: 不要怕！满满可是正义的骑士，满满会帮你狠狠教训他们的！

say:17:1220405013:1.text: Don't be naive, little hamster. This is Rustport. Helping this guy means going against the bookies.
say:17:1220405013:1.source_cn: 别天真了，小仓鼠，这儿是锈锚港。你帮这个小子，就是在断...

say:18:1220405014:1.text: You can stand up for him now, but once you're gone, the bookies will find plenty of ways to deal with him.
say:18:1220405014:1.source_cn: 现在你能为他出头，等你们走了，庄家有得是办法搞死他。

say:19:1220405015:1.text: I'm not afraid, and I won't throw a fight! I won't back down to anyone!
say:19:1220405015:1.source_cn: 我不怕！我不想打假拳，我不想这样随便输给对手！

say:20:1220405016:1.text: Kid, throwing fights is a "tradition" in Rustport. Even the Whispers can't break the rules of the streets.
say:20:1220405016:1.source_cn: 小子，打假拳是锈锚港的“规矩”，就算是我们血薇帮也不能...

say:21:1220405017:1.text: …Fine, but I won't submit. I… I'm in the ring to win!
say:21:1220405017:1.source_cn: ……好吧，但我不会屈服的。我……我站在拳台上，就是要赢！

say:22:1220405018:1.text: Stubborn kid... All I can do is wish you good luck.
say:22:1220405018:1.source_cn: 天真的小子，那就只能祝你好运了。
